transcript: You know what they say, when one queer parody show closes, another must rise up and take its place. And I am happy to say, if you're one of the people that love Titanic, I think you're really gonna love Ginger Twinsies. This one is not a musical, it is still filled to the brim with references to media that you love. It is, of course, primarily based on the 1998 film The Parent Trap, but it's referencing everything from The Devil Wears Prada to Mortal Kombat. These references tend to pull from millennial and queer media, so if you are in either or both of those two groups, you'll probably really love this. I personally found myself pretty consistently laughing throughout, and given that it's only 80 minutes, no intermission, it really does fly by. It also helps that it is one of the funniest ensemble of actors ever assembled, including some that you may know from TikTok, like Grace Ryder and Mitch Wood. it does rely pretty heavily on references to the 1998 Parent Trap film, so if that is a film you haven't seen or don't really have an affinity for, I don't know if this will be your cup of tea, but if you love The Parent Trap and you love these types of parody shows, I really think you're gonna like Ginger Twinsies.
reasoning: The transcript is reviewing 'Ginger Twinsies' (a Parent Trap parody), not 'Titanique' as specified in the prompt. The reviewer discusses Parent Trap references, ensemble cast, and 80-minute runtime - none of which relate to Titanique.
